an7.9:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] sattannaṃ bhikkhave, saññojanānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya brahmacariyaṃ vussati.
an7.9:1.3: anunayasaññojanassa pahānāya samucchedāya brahmacariyaṃ vussati. paṭighasaññojanassa …pe…
an7.9:1.9: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave, sattannaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya brahmacariyaṃ vussati.
an7.9:1.10: yato ca kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno anunaya saññojanaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvakataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhammaṃ
an7.9:1.16: …pe… avijjāsaññojanaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvakataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhammaṃ,
an7.9:1.17: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, bhikkhu acchecchi taṇhaṃ, vāvattayi saññojanaṃ, sammā mānābhi samayā antamakāsi dukkhassāti.
